title: Pre-Market Brief — 11 Aug 2026
intro: US equity futures drift modestly lower in pre-market trading as semiconductor weakness offsets strength in mega-cap tech and cloud names.

sections.heading: 🎯 TOP MOVERS
sections.content:
NVDA $217.55 (-2.86%) — semiconductor sector weakness dragging chipmakers — watching $215 support
AMD $469.56 (-2.86%) — tandem decline with NVDA hits semis — $465 critical

sections.heading: 🏦 SECTOR THEME
sections.content:
Rotation favors cloud hyperscalers and select financials while semiconductors face profit-taking pressure after recent rally.

sections.heading: ⚠️ RISKS
